The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) [proposed a noise-based standard](https://news.google.?oc=5) to replace the overland supersonic flight ban, which would serve as the first step toward fully authorizing such operations over land. In other regulatory updates, the FAA [cleared a drone](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxNbk9tcmo2YWEzamtBZ1lvYlpBejd2M3JQWEFrdmNxNEVWX3l0SU42QnNRR3psSTFycWdvOEc3T2F4NnZXNFBZRkoySDFpaTdUUDVIYXV6amZxZVVMR2F1UndHZmZHRW9xNGJySE1DdEpzZEhDX3EtSHZ2N0ZXTVpXVDgwelpKUGVGM1RDMy1jM3hTUC10dTNJ?oc=5) for avalanche-control operations in the United States.

Federal agencies are expanding counter-drone capabilities and security frameworks. The Department of Defense [awarded CACI a $100 million contract](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivAFBVV95cUxPUlJuRXBzNFVreXdlZUgzX1p5VUxDTm9wTUdQNmVodThWdy12dGdxNkhXRXM1SWJZWHRHWGxFN1h2ZGthYlJtNkJJRjllY0cyUU5lYWp5d3ZxTlFjemQ2VGtsTFJHazVKX3dTd3NFODhLY1FjTXNCRnY4MmpuelhmZ0JMQmxMVzBSYlRsX08tUzRBdW9YMVV1N24xUGlhT0w1Qk9DSjZORnVMNl8zOTVPMUlmN2hUUDVYcjc2cQ?oc=5) to provide counter-UAS capabilities for southern-border defense, while the Federal Bureau of Investigation [issued a SAFER SKIES](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTFBzMFctbEV1ZFpIN1gzU09ySUc0Smk0WnQwcUYyVDFybFF1YkF0Z1VaSGtKdE92VGtQdDFCaTM1S0xGVEpubnZRRTY1aHdtUnJRcXp6Ynl5N2Joa3A2VFo0RTJGSXNhaG5EQjdnRGgxcTlzQlI5UDZkejB1Zw?oc=5) counter-drone operations framework. Additionally, AT&T and Ericsson [demonstrated drone-detection technology](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqgFBVV95cUxORjVmd3hhYWFJd3B4bmwwY1FZQkRGVjdGMGxUc2VWdklHNnFjNUlJZV9lYkxkZjJUbDJZbzBDVGtXazhfTm5Qc00yaGoyRlVpb3RHVXJqcVp5Q2tFNEhJQXZIX3dScWtSUzVzaGRFQTN4VUtlSWRmWVhiR3BCN2ozVHVBU2dFalJqUklKU2tKYzlndXhuOE51Rmp6bFE1VndjTnNCZGNVSU5UZw?oc=5) near AT&T Stadium in Arlington.

The autonomous vehicle sector shows a trend of simultaneous technical progress and increased regulatory friction. Tesla [began employee rides](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxOX0pGcjdSR0s5Z1YzX3FXMXNjYTQ1N2dFMmczbUJ5eXEwcFVuQTFoRjlRTUFMX3QxQVUzd29ocFNZeHpGNUhBYUo5ZzJucWc3SEIzbi02RVR4RmIxRGpzOTdPUndDTHhOd2ZDUWQyTTNmWjdEbUlDWFNHRWpmMmJIcDh4QlZTV3prYmNZdWRIbFl2UExSNWZRQUJMM0tKeHBKSW02QTJxN2laY1VQ?oc=5) in its Cybercab at Gigafactory Texas, yet [Washington, D.C. and San Francisco](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwAJBVV95cUxPajZteXJfTHhlOWxGZ0F2TnpWUHlSWWxibnMwNVdLaU1BOW9BZjZzVEJCNlpmQVF0YTBfcnlUZG9RQlROY3FpMEhfRExwY19lQnoyRHhNcnN2NEZ2ZzdOWW9vNmlYOXNjWHJtalQydFhicW1ITERlc2hOUUhVclpWc19ENzRD
